senses.gloss: Ardravalika, n. of a nāga king: Māy 〔246.29〕.

ārddha (?), Mv 〔i.253.4〕, Senart rogajātā ārddhā, but mss. ˚jātānāddhe or ˚nārddhe; text and mg. obscure; Senartʼs note takes ār˚ as adj. from ṛddhi, (diseases) produced by magic, which does not seem to me plausible. But [] I have no interpretation to propose. Followed by maṇḍalako ca adhivāso ca, qq.v.
Ārdravallipratirūpa, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.141.5〕.
